title: Seven majority planes in 75 word-RAM primitives

claims.statement: The stated encoder and fixed majority plane decoder in proof.md give uniform-message average block error at most the submitted rational B, the upward rounding of 1-(243/250)^448*(9/10)^552 to a multiple of 10^-250 for 1000 bits on 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder uses exactly W=75 primitives for every received word, and W<=2^(623/100).

experiments.purpose: Compute the exact average error, cross-check the worst-case exponent, and exercise the counted fixed schedule.
